_comment: CANVAS.md §4.2 / §5: the canvas dialect the three clients share (markdown.ts parseBlocks(body, {canvas: true}), MessageBodyView.swift, BodyTokenizer.kt), ticking a task line, and keeping the caret when the body is replaced. Block descriptors: heading {level, text}, paragraph {lines}, list {ordered, items}, task {items: [{level, done, text, line}]}, image {alt, attachment_id, line}, hr, codeblock {text}. `text` is what the reader sees of the inline tokens (a link shows its label; emphasis markers are gone). Lines are 0-based.

blocks.name: tasks: open and done boxes, * and X, two spaces nest
blocks.body:
- [ ] 資料を集める
- [x] 発表練習
* [X] 予稿
  - [ ] 入れ子

blocks.name: a bullet list stops where tasks start
blocks.body:
- 出席: alice
- [ ] 担当を決める

blocks.name: an empty task (a template's) is a task
not tasks: no space inside the box, no space after the bullet
blocks.body:
- [] 箱ではない
-[ ] これも

blocks.name: an image of the canvas on a line of its own; an outside image stays text
--- without blank lines around it is text
a rule at the start of the body
tasks inside a code fence stay code
messages (canvas: false) keep tasks as bullets

caret.name: a change after the caret leaves it
a change before the caret moves it with the text
changes above and below: the caret's line is found again
the caret's line itself changed: the end of the change

page_links._comment: M121 (WIKI.md §2.3): links of the canvas dialect (canvases and Docs pages) to a Docs page `[label](page:<uuid>)` and to a file `[label](attachment:<uuid>)` (not an image line). `links`: every link token of the body in order, as {url, label}. With `canvas: false` (a message) they stay text and `links` is empty. The phones join in M122; the desktop reads this section from M121.
